    # GH #1225 (A4): a receipt that says `stored` leaves after the write, from
    # phase `done` -- never before the rows stand.
    out = []
    pid = str(uuid.uuid4())
    stash = {"lane": lane, "source": source, "candidates": kept, "withdraw": gone}
    if ack:
        stash["ack"] = {"source": source, "stored": len(kept), "refused": refused,
                        "ids": [str(k["row"].get("cand_id") or "") for k in kept]}
    hashes = [k["row"]["hash"] for k in kept]
    msg = stage_a(pid, stash, hashes)
    if kept:
        # What this source already holds under these ids, read to write each
        # (source, id) once and to keep the push's marks on one that did not
        # move (`cand_change`). Unfiltered: the writer's own key.
        msg["messages"].append({"origin": "assistant", "type": "tool_call", "id": "a-cands",
                                "text": json.dumps(sel(
                                    "candidates", ["cand_id", "hash", "triggers", "until",
                                                   "once", "priority", "audience_set"],
                                    {"source": source,
                                     "cand_id": {"in": sorted({k["row"]["cand_id"]
                                                               for k in kept})}}))})
    emit([msg] + out)

if lane == "in_addendum":
    # A gap's find, shown (GH #895): `./push` hands the `memory_recall` pair for
    # the round that opens with it, and the pair enters the wall HERE, with this
    # cell's own sequence numbers. The push sends it before the round's memory
    # ask leaves the hive and the round itself comes in only after the memory
    # answered, so the order of arrival puts the pair ahead of the round's first
    # turn -- no clock of a second writer decides it (OR-KX.K.1).
    session = str(hop.get("session_id") or ctx.get("session_id") or "default")
    turn = str(hop.get("turn_id") or ctx.get("turn_id") or "")
    elements = [m for m in (d.get("messages") or []) if isinstance(m, dict)]
    if not turn or not elements:
        park("in_addendum without a round or a pair -- nothing written")
    pid = str(uuid.uuid4())
    stash = {"lane": lane, "session": session, "turn": turn, "iter": "0",
             "messages": elements}
    emit([stage_a(pid, stash, [h for _, h, _ in with_nth(elements)], session, turn)])

if lane:
    park("unknown lane %r -- dropped" % lane)

# ================================================================= PHASES
if not op:
    park("a message with neither a lane nor a store answer -- dropped")

lg = legs(d)
if phase == "done":
    out = []
    why = str(ctx.get("cur_reason") or "")
    if why.startswith("ack:"):
        # GH #1225 (A4): the receipt of a candidate push, now that its rows
        # were written; a candidate whose write failed is refused `store_error`.
        try:
            a = json.loads(why[4:])
        except ValueError:
            a = {}
        ids, bad = list(a.get("ids") or []), []
        for cid, leg in lg.items():
            # The row's block too (re-check M-7): a row naming a block the
            # store refused is not stored.
            if leg["error_code"] and cid[:4] in ("bc-i", "bc-u", "bc-b") and cid[4:].isdigit():
                if int(cid[4:]) < len(ids) and ids[int(cid[4:])] not in bad:
                    bad.append(ids[int(cid[4:])])
        out.append({"header": {"route": "candidate_ack", "error_code": ""}, "messages": [],
                    "source": str(a.get("source") or ""),
                    "stored": max(0, int(a.get("stored") or 0) - len(bad)),
                    "refused": list(a.get("refused") or [])
                    + [{"id": b, "error_code": "store_error"} for b in bad]})
    for cid, leg in lg.items():
        if leg["error_code"] == "unique_violation" and "-sp" in cid:
            # GH #1225: a pack write that met a collector row under the
            # unique index -- the collector holds the path (`slot_ops`).
            continue
        if leg["error_code"]:
            sys.stderr.write("curator/intake: ledger write %s failed: %s\n"
                             % (cid, leg["error_code"]))
    emit(out)

if phase == "s":
    # GH #1225 (A13): the parked values `sweep_candidates` named. One older
    # than `pending_sweep_s` is dropped, with ONE `pending_swept` mark; a young
    # one is remembered and not read again until it is old; one without
    # `parked_at` is never swept.
    if (lg.get("s-rows") or {}).get("error_code"):
        # A read that failed sweeps nothing and says so; the next round reads again.
        park("parked rows could not be read for the sweep (%s) -- nothing swept"
             % lg["s-rows"]["error_code"])
    cut, old = sweep_cut(), []
    for r in rows(lg, "s-rows"):
        k = str(r.get("key") or "")
        try:
            v = json.loads(str(r.get("value") or ""))
        except ValueError:
            continue
        at = v.get("parked_at") if isinstance(v, dict) else None
        if not isinstance(at, str) or not at:
            continue
        if at < cut:
            old.append(k)
        else:
            _MEM["parked"][k] = at
    if not old:
        emit([])
    # One delete per key (re-check I-5): the mark names only the rows the
    # store says it took (phase `sd`) -- a row another cell swept first is
    # not named twice.
    sops = [("s-d%d" % i, {"operation": "delete", "table": "state", "where": {"key": k}})
            for i, k in enumerate(old)]
    emit([lstore(sops, "sd", ME, "", str(ctx.get("cur_reason") or "") + "\t"
                 + json.dumps(old))])

if phase == "sd":
    sess, _, rest = str(ctx.get("cur_reason") or "").partition("\t")
    trn, _, named = rest.partition("\t")
    try:
        old = json.loads(named or "[]")
    except ValueError:
        old = []
    gone = []
    for i, k in enumerate(old if isinstance(old, list) else []):
        leg = lg.get("s-d%d" % i) or {}
        if leg.get("error_code"):
            sys.stderr.write("curator/intake: sweep of %s failed: %s\n" % (k, leg["error_code"]))
        elif leg.get("rows_affected"):
            gone.append(str(k))
    if not gone:
        emit([])
    emit([lstore(mark_ops("sm", sess, trn, [("pending_swept", canonical(
        {"keys": gone, "older_than_s": PENDING_SWEEP_S}))], now()), "done", ME, "", "")])

if phase == "h":
    # GH #1225 (re-check I-4): one page of the ledger-wide heal. An older
    # ledger may hold one episode index twice in a round (two turns minted it
    # under a child killed between them) or one pin twice (a model's pin
    # written as a copy): every copy of an index after its first row (by seq)
    # holds none any more, every pin copy is written again as one row -- and
    # the next wake builds `wall_episode`/`pins_round`. Done once per ledger
    # (`state` `heal:gh1225`), said once with `episode_healed`.
    run, _, cursor = str(ctx.get("cur_reason") or "").partition("\t")
    heal = _MEM["heal"]
    if not isinstance(heal, dict) or heal.get("run") != run:
        # A page of a child before this one: this child heals on its own.
        park("heal page of another child -- dropped")
    bad = ["%s=%s" % (c, lg[c]["error_code"]) for c in ("h-stamp", "h-wall", "h-pins")
           if (lg.get(c) or {}).get("error_code")]
    if bad:
        _MEM["heal"] = None
        park("the heal of the ledger could not read (%s) -- the next round tries again"
             % ",".join(bad))
    if "h-stamp" in lg:
        # The stamp alone first (delta check of KR): the pins and the wall
        # only for a ledger that never healed.
        if rows(lg, "h-stamp"):
            park("")
        emit([heal_page(0, True)])
    hops, later = [], []
    page = rows(lg, "h-wall")
    for r in page:
        i, sq = r.get("episode_idx"), r.get("seq")
        if i is None or sq is None:
            continue
        k = (str(r.get("session_id") or ""), str(r.get("audience_set") or ""), int(i))
        if k in heal["firsts"]:
            later.append(int(sq))
        else:
            heal["firsts"].add(k)
    if later:
        heal["rows"] += len(later)
        hops.append(("bw-heal", {"operation": "update", "table": "wall",
                                "set": {"episode_idx": None}, "where": {"seq": {"in": later}}}))
    if "h-pins" in lg:
        seen, pin_copies = {}, 0
        for r in rows(lg, "h-pins"):
            k = (str(r.get("hash") or ""), str(r.get("source") or ""), r.get("audience_set"))
            seen.setdefault(k, []).append(r)
        for n, (k, rs) in enumerate(sorted(seen.items(), key=lambda kv: str(kv[0]))):
            if len(rs) < 2:
                continue
            pin_copies += len(rs) - 1
            keep = max(rs, key=lambda r: str(r.get("at") or ""))
            op = ins("pins", {c: keep.get(c) for c in ("hash", "source", "until", "at",
                                                       "audience_set")})
            op["replace"] = {"hash": k[0], "source": k[1],
                             "audience_set": k[2] if k[2] is not None else {"is_null": True}}
            hops.append(("h-pin%d" % n, op))
        if pin_copies:
            sys.stderr.write("curator/intake: %d pin copies written again as one row\n"
                             % pin_copies)
    top = int(page[-1].get("seq") or 0) if page else 0
    if len(page) >= HEAL_PAGE:
        emit(([lstore(hops, "done", ME, "", "")] if hops else []) + [heal_page(top, False)])
    if heal["rows"]:
        sys.stderr.write("curator/intake: %d wall rows shared an episode index -- the later"
                         " ones hold none now\n" % heal["rows"])
        hops += mark_ops("h-m", "", "", [("episode_healed", str(heal["rows"]))], now())
    done = ins("state", {"key": HEAL_KEY, "value": now()})
    done["if_absent"] = {"key": HEAL_KEY}
    hops.append(("h-done", done))
    emit([lstore(hops, "done", ME, "", "")])

if phase == "e":
    # GH #1225 (A2): the episode rows of a turn whose step A another child
    # sent -- written without an index, claimed here. This read follows every
    # B that child sent (the ledger answers in order), and the RAM holds every
    # B of this child after it, so the index is free; a row that already holds
    # one, or was never written, is left alone, and only a claimed row hands
    # its episode on: `turn_write` never names one id twice.
    pid = str(ctx.get("cur_call") or "")
    bad = ["%s=%s" % (c, lg[c]["error_code"]) for c in ("e-echo", "e-epi", "e-rows")
           if (lg.get(c) or {}).get("error_code")]
    if bad:
        # Never a guess over a read that failed: the rows stand without an
        # index, no episode id is handed on, the parked claims wait for the
        # sweep -- said.
        park("episode claims of %s: a read failed (%s) -- the rows stand without an index,"
             " nothing handed on" % (pid, ",".join(bad)))
    echo = rows(lg, "e-echo")
    try:
        pay = json.loads(str(echo[0].get("value") or "{}")) if echo else {}
    except ValueError:
        pay = {}
    if not isinstance(pay, dict) or not pay.get("claims"):
        park("episode claims came back without their payload (%s) -- dropped" % pid)
    session = str(pay.get("session") or "")
    epi = rows(lg, "e-epi")
    last = int(epi[0].get("episode_idx")) if epi and epi[0].get("episode_idx") is not None else -1
    in_flight(pay.get("epoch"))
    last = max(last, _MEM["floor"].get((session, ROW_AUDIENCE), -1))
    open_rows = {(str(r.get("turn_id") or ""), str(r.get("hash") or ""), int(r.get("nth") or 0))
                 for r in rows(lg, "e-rows") if r.get("episode_idx") is None}
    _MEM["epoch"] += 1
    cops, eps = [], {}
    for i, c in enumerate(pay.get("claims") or []):
        s_, t_, h_, n_ = c.get("key") or ["", "", "", 0]
        if (str(t_), str(h_), int(n_)) not in open_rows:
            continue
        last += 1
        cops.append(("e-c%d" % i, {"operation": "update", "table": "wall",
                                   "set": {"episode_idx": last},
                                   "where": {"session_id": s_, "turn_id": t_, "hash": h_,
                                             "nth": n_, "episode_idx": {"is_null": True}}}))
        eps["e-c%d" % i] = [last, [s_, t_, h_, n_]]
    if not eps:
        # Nothing to claim: the parked claims hand nothing on.
        emit([lstore([("e-drop", episode_drop(pid))], "done", ME, "", "")])
    # The floor now, before the store answers: a refused claim leaves a
    # gap, never an index minted twice.
    handed_on(session, last)
    # Re-check I-1: the episodes go on only from the store's answer to the
    # claims (phase `ec`) -- a claim the store refused hands nothing on; its
    # row stands without an index, like a row whose read failed. The parked
    # claims are read once more in the same bundle (their words never ride a
    # header) and dropped only once their episodes left (delta check of KR).
    cops.append(("e-again", episode_reread(pid)))
    emit([lstore(cops, "ec", ME, pid, json.dumps({"claims": eps}, sort_keys=True))])

if phase == "ec":
    # GH #1225 (delta check of KR): the claims the store took hand their
    # episodes on, and only then are the parked claims dropped. A read of
    # them that failed is read once more from this answer (`e-again2`, no
    # timer); refused twice, the claimed index is freed again -- a row
    # without an index, like a refused claim, never an index without its
    # episode -- and the parked claims stay for the sweep, said with ONE
    # `store_error` mark `{step: "ec", legs}`.
    pid = str(ctx.get("cur_call") or "")
    try:
        st = json.loads(str(ctx.get("cur_reason") or "") or "{}")
    except ValueError:
        st = {}
    st = st if isinstance(st, dict) else {}
    claimed = st.get("claims") if isinstance(st.get("claims"), dict) else {}
    first = st.get("first")
    if first is None:
        # The claim bundle: which claims the store took.
        took, refused = {}, []
        for cid, v in sorted(claimed.items(), key=lambda kv: str(kv[1])):
            leg = lg.get(cid) or {}
            if leg.get("error_code") or not leg.get("rows_affected"):
                refused.append("%s=%s" % (v[0], leg.get("error_code") or "no row"))
            else:
                took[cid] = v
        if refused:
            sys.stderr.write("curator/intake: episode claims not handed on (%s) -- a refused"
                             " claim leaves its row without an index\n" % ",".join(refused))
        claimed = took
    rid = "e-again" if first is None else "e-again2"
    code = (lg.get(rid) or {}).get("error_code") or ""
    again = [] if (lg.get(rid) or {}).get("error_code") else rows(lg, rid)
    try:
        pay = json.loads(str(again[0].get("value") or "{}")) if again else {}
    except ValueError:
        pay = {}
    claims = (pay.get("claims") if isinstance(pay, dict) else None) or []
    if not claimed:
        emit([lstore([("e-drop", episode_drop(pid))], "done", ME, "", "")])
    if not claims and first is None:
        sys.stderr.write("curator/intake: the parked claims of %s could not be read (%s) --"
                         " read once more\n" % (pid, code or "no row"))
        emit([lstore([("e-again2", episode_reread(pid))], "ec", ME, pid, json.dumps(
            {"claims": claimed, "first": code or "no_row"}, sort_keys=True))])
    took, free = [], []
    for cid, (idx, key) in sorted(claimed.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1][0]):
        i = int(cid[3:]) if cid[3:].isdigit() else -1
        c = claims[i] if 0 <= i < len(claims) and isinstance(claims[i], dict) else None
        if c is None:
            free.append((cid, idx, key))
        else:
            took.append(dict(c.get("ep") or {}, index=idx))
    fops = []
    for cid, idx, key in free:
        s_, t_, h_, n_ = key
        fops.append(("e-free%s" % cid[3:], {"operation": "update", "table": "wall",
                                            "set": {"episode_idx": None},
                                            "where": {"session_id": s_, "turn_id": t_,
                                                      "hash": h_, "nth": n_,
                                                      "episode_idx": idx}}))
    if free:
        s_, t_ = free[0][2][0], free[0][2][1]
        # A claim missing from a payload that was read (never written so) is
        # named as that read; refused twice, both reads are named.
        legs_ = {"e-again": "no_claim"} if first is None else {
            "e-again": str(first), "e-again2": code or "no_row"}
        sys.stderr.write("curator/intake: the parked claims of %s could not be read twice (%s)"
                         " -- %d claimed index(es) freed, the claims stay for the sweep\n"
                         % (pid, ",".join("%s=%s" % kv for kv in sorted(legs_.items())),
                            len(free)))
        fops += mark_ops("e-se", s_, t_, [("store_error", canonical(
            {"step": "ec", "legs": legs_}))], now())
    else:
        fops.append(("e-drop", episode_drop(pid)))
    out = [{"header": {"route": "episode"}, "messages": [], "episodes": took}] if took else []
    emit(out + [lstore(fops, "done", ME, "", "")])

if phase == "v":
    # GH #1079: the words of the round came back -- the blocks of the rows
    # step A found, beside the parked section. Check it, hand it on, and drop
    # what was parked.
    for cid, leg in lg.items():
        if leg["error_code"]:
            sys.stderr.write("curator/intake: ledger op %s failed: %s\n"
                             % (cid, leg["error_code"]))
    pid = str(ctx.get("cur_call") or "")
    echo = rows(lg, "v-echo")
    try:
        stash = json.loads(str(echo[0].get("value") or "{}")) if echo else {}
    except ValueError:
        stash = {}
    check = stash.get("verify") if isinstance(stash, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(check, dict):
        park("a checked section came back without its payload (%s) -- dropped" % pid)
    if check.get("by_source"):
        # GH #1225: the words of every source, and the turn's own for a field
        # under the rules of before.
        groups = {}
        for e in check.get("src") or []:
            groups.setdefault(str(e[0]), set()).add((str(e[1]), int(e[2])))
        turns, recalls, bodies = [], [], []
        for r in rows(lg, "v-blocks"):
            try:
                el = json.loads(str(r.get("body") or "null"))
            except ValueError:
                continue
            if not isinstance(el, dict) or not isinstance(el.get("text"), str):
                continue
            for g, of_turn in sorted(groups.get(str(r.get("hash") or ""), ())):
                if g in ("user", "peer") and of_turn:
                    turns.append(el["text"])
                if g == "recall" and el.get("type") == "tool_result":
                    recalls.append(el["text"])
                elif g != "recall":
                    bodies.append((g, el))
        drop = [("v-drop", {"operation": "delete", "table": "state",
                            "where": {"key": pending_key(pid)}})]
        vs, vmarks = verified_section(check, turns, recalls,
                                      source_pools(bodies, str(check.get("answer") or "")),
                                      bool((lg.get("v-blocks") or {}).get("error_code")))
        drop += mark_ops("vm", str(check.get("session") or ""), str(check.get("turn") or ""),
                         vmarks, now())
        emit([lstore(drop, "done", ME, pid, "")] + vs)
    kinds = {str(h): str(k) for h, k in (check.get("src") or [])}
    turns, recalls = [], []
    for r in rows(lg, "v-blocks"):
        kind = kinds.get(str(r.get("hash") or ""), "")
        try:
            el = json.loads(str(r.get("body") or "null"))
        except ValueError:
            continue
        if not isinstance(el, dict) or not isinstance(el.get("text"), str):
            continue
        if kind in ("user", "peer"):
            turns.append(el["text"])
        elif kind == "recall" and el.get("type") == "tool_result":
            # The memory bundle of the round is the recall's answer, never
            # its question.
            recalls.append(el["text"])
    drop = [("v-drop", {"operation": "delete", "table": "state",
                        "where": {"key": pending_key(pid)}})]
    emit([lstore(drop, "done", ME, pid, "")]
         + verified_section(check, turns, recalls, None,
                            bool((lg.get("v-blocks") or {}).get("error_code")))[0])

if phase != "a":
    park("store answer in unknown phase %r -- dropped" % phase)

echo = rows(lg, "a-echo")
if not echo:
    park("step A came back without its payload (%s) -- dropped"
         % ",".join("%s=%s" % (k, v["error_code"]) for k, v in lg.items() if v["error_code"]))
pid = str(ctx.get("cur_call") or "")
try:
    stash = json.loads(str(echo[0].get("value") or "{}"))
except Exception:
    park("unreadable payload %s -- dropped" % pid)
kind_lane = str(stash.get("lane") or "")
stamp = now()
extra = []
# Re-check M-5: a read that failed is said -- `a-seq` leaves only this
# child's RAM as the floor of the sequence, `a-said` no episode on the hop,
# `a-marks` writes no tap mark (below) rather than one twice, `a-slots` names
# no tool of the menu (`unknown`) and writes every slot by its `replace` step.
for c in [c for c in ("a-seq", "a-said", "a-marks", "a-slots") if (lg.get(c) or {}).get("error_code")]:
    sys.stderr.write("curator/intake: read %s failed: %s\n" % (c, lg[c]["error_code"]))
seq_top = rows(lg, "a-seq")
if seq_top and str(seq_top[0].get("seq") if seq_top[0].get("seq") is not None else "").lstrip("-").isdigit():
    # GH #1225 (A10): never below a row that stands.
    _MEM["seq"] = max(_MEM["seq"], int(seq_top[0].get("seq")))
have_blocks = {str(r.get("hash") or "") for r in rows(lg, "a-blocks")}
current_slots = rows(lg, "a-slots")
ops, out = [], []

# -- marks (a section of the model's block) -------------------------------
have_marks = {(str(r.get("kind") or ""), str(r.get("value") or ""))
              for r in rows(lg, "a-marks")}
if kind_lane == "in_section":
    fresh = [(k, v) for k, v in (tuple(m) for m in (stash.get("marks") or []))
             if (k, v) not in have_marks]
    ops += mark_ops("bm", str(stash.get("session") or ""), str(stash.get("turn") or ""),
                    fresh, stamp)
    check = stash.get("verify")
    if isinstance(check, dict):
        # GH #1079: the rows the rule reads, by hash and kind. Their words are
        # blocks, so one more round trip fetches them -- with the parked
        # section, the kinds written into it (a block's own kind is the one it
        # was first seen under, the row's is this round's).
        if check.get("by_source"):
            src = source_src(check, rows(lg, "a-src"), rows(lg, "a-esrc"))
            failed_read = any((lg.get(c) or {}).get("error_code") for c in ("a-src", "a-esrc"))
        else:
            src = sorted({(str(r.get("hash") or ""), str(r.get("kind") or ""))
                          for r in rows(lg, "a-src") if r.get("hash")})
            # GH #1225 (A3): a failed read of the round is `store_error`.
            failed_read = bool((lg.get("a-src") or {}).get("error_code"))
        if failed_read or not src:
            vs, vmarks = verified_section(check, [], [], source_pools([], check.get("answer")),
                                          failed_read)
            out += vs
            ops += mark_ops("vm", str(check.get("session") or ""), str(check.get("turn") or ""),
                            vmarks, stamp)
        else:
            check["src"] = [list(p) for p in src]
            stash["verify"] = check
            ops.append(("v-put", {"operation": "update", "table": "state",
                                  "set": {"value": canonical(stash)},
                                  "where": {"key": pending_key(pid)}}))
            ops.append(("v-echo", sel("state", ["key", "value"], {"key": pending_key(pid)})))
            ops.append(("v-blocks", sel("blocks", ["hash", "body"],
                                        {"hash": {"in": sorted({e[0] for e in src})}})))
            emit([lstore(ops, "v", ME, pid, kind_lane)])

# -- pins (another hive's `in_pin`) ----------------------------------------
if kind_lane == "in_pin":
    # By hash: its `until` and its audience (GH #925), each as the door
    # writes it, so "the same again" compares like with like.
    items = []
    # `replace_sources` (GH #916): every live pin of the named sources ends
    # now -- `until` set, no row deleted -- EXCEPT one the new set carries: a
    # live hash pinned again stays alive (ending it first and then finding
    # "same text, same until, nothing to do" below would leave it dead). A hash
    # whose row already ended lives again through the `until` update below.
    keep = {str((p.get("row") or {}).get("hash") or "") for p in (stash.get("pins") or [])}
    keep |= {str(h) for h in (stash.get("held") or [])}
    as_of = datetime.datetime.strptime(stamp, FMT).replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
    sources = [str(x) for x in (stash.get("replace") or [])]
    live_unread = (lg.get("a-live") or {}).get("error_code") or ""
    if sources and stash.get("held") and live_unread:
        # Re-check I-2: the live set could not be read -- never "nothing
        # live". The pins of the message are written; what the replacement
        # would have ended stays live until the next one, said.
        sys.stderr.write("curator/intake: the live pins of %s could not be read (%s) --"
                         " nothing ended\n" % (",".join(sources), live_unread))
    elif sources and stash.get("held"):
        ending = sorted({str(r.get("hash") or "") for r in rows(lg, "a-live")
                         if str(r.get("hash") or "") not in keep
                         and pin_live(r.get("until"), as_of)} - {""})
        if ending:
            ops.append(("bp-end", {"operation": "update", "table": "pins",
                                   "set": {"until": stamp},
                                   "where": {"source": {"in": sources}, "hash": {"in": ending}}}))
    elif sources:
        # GH #1225 (A4): ONE bundle, no read before it -- every live pin of
        # the sources ends now, then the new set stands again by its
        # `replace` below. Two replacements in flight: the one sent last wins
        # whole (bundles of this cell reach the ledger in order).
        ops.append(("bp-end", {"operation": "update", "table": "pins", "set": {"until": stamp},
                               "where": {"source": {"in": sources},
                                         "until": {"or_null": {"gt": stamp}}}}))
        ops.append(("bp-end0", {"operation": "update", "table": "pins", "set": {"until": stamp},
                                "where": {"source": {"in": sources}, "until": ""}}))
    for i, p in enumerate(stash.get("pins") or []):
        row = p.get("row") or {}
        h = str(row.get("hash") or "")
        items.append((p.get("element") or {}, h, "pin"))
        until = str(row.get("until") or "")
        # GH #972 -- the round the door gave THIS pin (`pin_round`); a stash
        # from before carries none and stands in the message's round.
        rnd = audience_of(row.get("audience_set")) or ROW_AUDIENCE
        # ONE step per pin (GH #1225, A4): `insert` with `replace` on
        # (hash, source) under the unique index `pins_round` -- the same text
        # pinned again takes the new `until` and the round of THIS pin
        # (OR-BD.A.3: the latest door decides who it stands for and how long),
        # and no read decides between insert and update.
        op = ins("pins", dict(row, audience_set=rnd, until=until))
        op["replace"] = {"hash": h, "source": str(row.get("source") or "")}
        ops.append(("bp-i%d" % i, op))
    ops += block_ops(items, have_blocks, stamp, "bp")

# -- candidates (another hive's `in_candidate`, GH #949) --------------------
if kind_lane == "in_candidate":
    source = str(stash.get("source") or "")
    gone = [str(g) for g in (stash.get("withdraw") or [])]
    held = {str(r.get("cand_id") or ""): r for r in rows(lg, "a-cands")}
    items, writes, named = [], [], set()
    cands_unread = (lg.get("a-cands") or {}).get("error_code") or ""
    if cands_unread:
        # Re-check I-2: a stored row that could not be read is never "no row"
        # -- the replace would take its use and its cooldown. Nothing of the
        # push is written, every candidate refused `store_error`, said.
        sys.stderr.write("curator/intake: the candidates of %s could not be read (%s) --"
                         " nothing written\n" % (source, cands_unread))
    for i, c in enumerate([] if cands_unread else (stash.get("candidates") or [])):
        row = dict(c.get("row") or {})
        cid = str(row.get("cand_id") or "")
        named.add(cid)
        if cid in gone:
            # Withdrawn in the message it came in: kept, and over at once.
            row["until"] = stamp
        items.append((c.get("element") or {}, str(row.get("hash") or ""), CAND_KIND))
        old = held.get(cid)
        if old is None:
            # GH #1225 (A4): ONE step on the unique `candidates_key` -- a
            # second push of the id in flight replaces, the one sent last wins.
            op = ins("candidates", dict(row, used_at="", last_seq=0, at=stamp))
            op["replace"] = {"source": source, "cand_id": cid}
            writes.append(("bc-i%d" % i, op))
            continue
        write, reset = cand_change(old, row)
        if not write:
            continue
        put = {k: row[k] for k in ("hash", "triggers", "until", "once", "priority",
                                   "audience_set")}
        put["at"] = stamp
        if reset:
            put.update(used_at="", last_seq=0)
        writes.append(("bc-u%d" % i, {"operation": "update", "table": "candidates",
                                      "set": put,
                                      "where": {"source": source, "cand_id": cid}}))
    # The blocks first: a row never names a text the ledger does not hold yet.
    ops += block_ops(items, have_blocks, stamp, "bc")
    ops += writes
    rest = [] if cands_unread else sorted(set(gone) - named)
    if rest:
        # `withdraw` (GH #949): over now -- `until` set, no row deleted, the
        # visibility rule of an `until` that ran out, as `replace_sources`
        # ends a pin.
        ops.append(("bc-end", {"operation": "update", "table": "candidates",
                               "set": {"until": stamp},
                               "where": {"source": source, "cand_id": {"in": rest}}}))

# -- slots (collector / pack) ---------------------------------------------
if kind_lane in ("in_curate", "in_slots", "in_pack"):
    sblocks, sops = slot_ops(current_slots, stash.get("system") or {},
                             str(stash.get("owner") or "collector"), stamp, "b")
    ops += block_ops(sblocks, have_blocks, stamp, "bs")
    ops += sops

# -- wall rows (curate / tap) ----------------------------------------------
episodes = []
if kind_lane in ("in_curate", "in_llm", "in_addendum"):
    session, turn = str(stash.get("session") or ""), str(stash.get("turn") or "")
    try:
        it = int(str(stash.get("iter") or "0"))
    except ValueError:
        it = 0
    elements = [m for m in (stash.get("messages") or []) if isinstance(m, dict)]
    triples = with_nth(elements)
    if kind_lane == "in_llm":
        kinds = ["assistant"] * len(elements)
        finals = [int(stash.get("final") or 0)] * len(elements)
    else:
        kinds = kinds_of(elements)
        # A round without a tool call that carries the agent's own words is a
        # turn cut on the model's clock (duplex voice, R-25-9): its answer half
        # is said, final, and an episode -- that model is not behind the tap.
        # Beside a tool call the same shape is prose on the way to a call. The
        # evidence pairs a collector hangs on every round (recall, brief) are
        # no call of the model's: counted, they kept every duplex answer half
        # of the shipped surface (talky `memory_tier` "1") out of the episodes
        # (review I-1).
        calls = any(k == "tool_call" for k in kinds)
        finals = [1 if k == "assistant" and not calls else 0 for k in kinds]
    items = [(el, h, k) for (el, h, _), k in zip(triples, kinds)]
    for (el, _, _), k, f in zip(triples, kinds, finals):
        if k == "assistant" and f:
            # The answer without its block is a block too: the window shows it
            # that way when the block is over its share of the window (GH #871,
            # GH #1085), and a call record names only blocks the ledger holds.
            bare = dict(el, text=stripped_text(str(el.get("text") or "")))
            items.append((bare, block_hash(bare), "assistant"))
    ops += block_ops(items, have_blocks, stamp, "bw")
    have_wall = {(str(r.get("hash") or ""), int(r.get("nth") or 0))
                 for r in rows(lg, "a-wall")}
    # GH #1225 (A3): a wall that could not be read writes nothing twice all
    # the same (every row is ONE `if_absent` step) -- said, and no tool mark
    # of this message, which the read would have made once.
    wall_failed = [c for c in ("a-wall", "a-epi") if (lg.get(c) or {}).get("error_code")]
    if wall_failed:
        sys.stderr.write("curator/intake: the wall of turn %s could not be read (%s) -- rows"
                         " written once by key, episodes claimed after\n"
                         % (turn, ",".join(wall_failed)))
    flight = in_flight(stash.get("epoch"))
    # (A2) Step A of another child -- or no index read: the episode rows go
    # in without an index and are claimed in a bundle of their own (phase e).
    ep0 = stash.get("epoch")
    claim = not (isinstance(ep0, list) and ep0[:1] == [_MEM["child"]]) or bool(wall_failed)
    epi = rows(lg, "a-epi")
    last_idx = int(epi[0].get("episode_idx")) if epi and epi[0].get("episode_idx") is not None else -1
    # Keyed by (session, audience) like the read above (OR-S3.K.1): never
    # below an index this child handed on (re-check I-1) -- a B the store
    # refused wrote no row, and its episode is with `./writer` all the same.
    last_idx = max(last_idx, _MEM["floor"].get((session, ROW_AUDIENCE), -1))
    fresh = []
    for (el, h, n), k, final in zip(triples, kinds, finals):
        key = (session, turn, h, n)
        if (h, n) in have_wall or (key in _MEM["wall"] and flight(_MEM["wall"][key][-1])):
            continue
        if k == "assistant" and not str(el.get("text") or ""):
            # An empty answer half says nothing and is refused by providers.
            continue
        fresh.append((el, h, n, k, final))
    seqs = next_seq(len(fresh)) if fresh else []
    # GH #1225 (K-1, OR-KF-5): the turn's own time on every wall row of a
    # replayed round, "" otherwise -- `./policy` ages a row by `turn_at or at`,
    # so a replayed week ages by its days and not by the minute it was
    # ingested in; `seq` and `at` stay the order and clock of ingest.
    turn_at = replay_time() or ""
    _MEM["epoch"] += 1
    claims, keyed = [], []
    for (el, h, n, k, final), seq in zip(fresh, seqs):
        _MEM["wall"][(session, turn, h, n)] = (_MEM["epoch"],)
        idx = None
        if k in ("user", "peer") or (k == "assistant" and final):
            if not claim:
                # A row sent again (its B refused) keeps the id it was
                # handed on with; a new one takes the next.
                idx = _MEM["ep_keys"].get((session, ROW_AUDIENCE, turn, h, n))
                if idx is None:
                    last_idx += 1
                    idx = last_idx
                keyed.append(((session, ROW_AUDIENCE, turn, h, n), idx))
            text = str(el.get("text") or "")
            # `audience`: the round the index counts in -- `./writer` makes it
            # part of the turn id, so two rounds of one session never collide.
            # GH #1018: the episode carries the turn's own time on a replay
            # channel; the wall row below keeps the ingest clock either way.
            ep = {"session_id": session, "iter": str(it),
                  "at": turn_at or stamp,
                  "role": k, "text": stripped_text(text) if k == "assistant" else text,
                  "audience": ROW_AUDIENCE}
            if k == "peer":
                ep["speaker"] = str(el.get("speaker") or "")
                ep["speaker_ref"] = str(el.get("speaker_ref") or "")
            if claim:
                claims.append({"key": [session, turn, h, n], "ep": ep})
            else:
                episodes.append(dict(ep, index=idx))
        # GH #1225 (A1): ONE step by the wall's own key -- a row written in
        # flight by another message, or by a child before this one, stays.
        wkey = {"session_id": session, "turn_id": turn, "hash": h, "nth": n}
        row = audienced({
            "seq": seq, "session_id": session, "turn_id": turn, "iter": it, "kind": k,
            "hash": h, "nth": n, "final": final, "episode_idx": idx, "at": stamp,
            "turn_at": turn_at})
        op = ins("wall", row)
        op["if_absent"] = wkey
        ops.append(("bw-w%d" % seq, op))
        if idx is not None:
            # (A2) The net under the unique index `wall_episode`: should the
            # index be taken after all, the row still stands, without it.
            net = ins("wall", dict(row, episode_idx=None))
            net["if_absent"] = wkey
            ops.append(("bw-n%d" % seq, net))
    if keyed:
        handed_on(session, last_idx, keyed)
    if claims:
        epid = str(ctx.get("cur_call") or "") + ":e"
        _MEM["parked"][pending_key(epid)] = stamp
        extra.append(lstore([
            ("e-put", ins("state", {"key": pending_key(epid), "value": canonical({
                "parked_at": stamp, "epoch": epoch_now(), "session": session,
                "claims": claims})})),
            ("e-echo", sel("state", ["key", "value"], {"key": pending_key(epid)})),
            ("e-epi", sel("wall", ["episode_idx"],
                          {"session_id": session, "audience_set": ROW_AUDIENCE,
                           "episode_idx": {"is_null": False}},
                          [("episode_idx", "desc")], 1)),
            ("e-rows", sel("wall", ["turn_id", "hash", "nth", "episode_idx"],
                           {"session_id": session, "turn_id": turn}))], "e", ME, epid, ""))
    if kind_lane == "in_curate" and not wall_failed:
        # GH #925: a tool that failed, once per result -- only a result written
        # as a new wall row now marks, so the wall's own key (and `_MEM`) makes
        # the mark exactly once. The tool's name is the call's of the same id
        # in the round, in code form or `unknown` (a name is the model's words
        # too, OR-BD-6); an evidence pair is `recall`/`brief`, never counted.
        # A name the menu does not hold is `unknown` as well (OR-BD-92): a
        # model can make one up out of the person's words in the form of a
        # name -- `lookup.alice-smith`, `my-secret` reached a judge as samples
        # (review of fix round 3, m5.py). The menu is what `slots` held before
        # this message (step A read it) and what its own `system` tree brings:
        # the call was made from the one, the result may come with the other.
        menu = {p[6:] for p in [str(r.get("path") or "") for r in current_slots]
                + [p for p, _ in leaves_of(stash.get("system") or {})[0]]
                if p.startswith("tools.")}
        names = {str(el.get("id") or ""): tool_name(el) for el in elements
                 if el.get("origin") == "assistant" and el.get("type") == "tool_call"}
        failed = []
        for el, _, _, k, _ in fresh:
            if k != "tool_result":
                continue
            bad, code = tool_failure(el)
            if bad:
                name = names.get(str(el.get("id") or "")) or ""
                name = (code_form(name) if name in menu else "") or "unknown"
                failed.append(("tool_error", "%s:%s" % (name, code or "error")))
        ops += mark_ops("bw-m", session, turn, failed, stamp)

# -- marks of the model's own output (the tap, GH #925) -------------------
if kind_lane == "in_llm":
    said_now = [] if (lg.get("a-marks") or {}).get("error_code") else [
        (k, v) for k, v in (tuple(m) for m in (stash.get("marks") or []))
        if (k, v) not in have_marks]
    ops += mark_ops("bk", str(stash.get("session") or ""), str(stash.get("turn") or ""),
                    said_now, stamp)

if episodes:
    out.append({"header": {"route": "episode"}, "messages": [], "episodes": episodes})

if kind_lane == "in_curate":
    # The plan of the window (GH #892): which rows the next call shows, fixed
    # between two rebuilds. It rides in the parked turn, so `./policy` renders
    # exactly the plan the rows below were read for.
    plan_text = str(((rows(lg, "a-plan") or [{}])[0]).get("value") or "")
    try:
        plan = json.loads(plan_text) if plan_text else {}
    except ValueError:
        plan = {}
    plan = plan if isinstance(plan, dict) else {}
    # GH #1225 (A3): a plan or a cover that could not be read is never cover
    # 0 -- that would hand the model the whole wall. The call goes with its own
    # round only, said, marked `store_error`, and the parked turn names what
    # was not read (`wall_unread`) for `./policy`.
    unread = [c for c in ("a-plan", "a-cover") if (lg.get(c) or {}).get("error_code")]
    if unread:
        plan, plan_text = {}, ""
        sys.stderr.write("curator/intake: the window plan of turn %s could not be read (%s)"
                         " -- the call shows its own round only\n" % (turn, ",".join(unread)))
        ops += mark_ops("bw-se", session, turn, [("store_error", canonical(
            {"step": "a", "legs": {c: lg[c]["error_code"] for c in unread}}))], stamp)
    cover = plan_cover(plan, rows(lg, "a-cover"))
    keep = [int(s) for s in (plan.get("keep") or []) if str(s).lstrip("-").isdigit()]
    slim = {k: stash.get(k) for k in ("lane", "session", "turn", "iter", "hop", "parked_at")}
    if unread:
        slim["wall_unread"] = unread
    # The person's episode of this turn, by the id `./writer` gives it (GH
    # #941): `./policy` hands the parked hop on with the model call, the brain
    # edge promotes it to `context.episode_turn_id`, and every sidecar section
    # of the answer carries it -- before, a section carried only the round's
    # uuid and a reader could not address the episode (`in_affect` with
    # `session_id` + `turn_id`) without minting the id itself. A fresh person
    # row of this call counts, else the latest one of the round in the session
    # (a tool round or a consult's advice answers it); a session without one
    # names none, and a value a caller put on the hop never passes.
    said_idx = [ep["index"] for ep in episodes if ep.get("role") in ("user", "peer")]
    for row in rows(lg, "a-said"):
        if str(row.get("episode_idx") if row.get("episode_idx") is not None else "").isdigit():
            said_idx.append(int(row.get("episode_idx")))
    hop_on = {k: v for k, v in dict(stash.get("hop") or {}).items() if k != "episode_turn_id"}
    if said_idx:
        hop_on["episode_turn_id"] = episode_turn_id(session, ROW_AUDIENCE, max(said_idx))
    slim["hop"] = hop_on
    slim["plan"] = plan_text if plan else ""
    if "tool_scope" in stash:
        slim["tool_scope"] = stash.get("tool_scope")
    # The slots of this call's session (review I-4): parked with its turn, the
    # one place `./policy` takes them from -- complete, because the collector
    # writes each of them on every assembly, empty included.
    slim["session_slots"] = session_leaves(stash.get("system") or {})
    ops.append(("b-slim", {"operation": "update", "table": "state",
                           "set": {"value": canonical(slim)},
                           "where": {"key": pending_key(pid)}}))
    ops.append(("b-slimq", sel("state", ["value"], {"key": pending_key(pid)})))
    # The hashes `./policy` fetches for the window (GH #932): only rows this
    # round may see, so the number of blocks fetched says nothing about
    # another round's. `slots` carry no audience: read with their paths, so
    # `./policy` drops the summary slot of another round (GH #943 review I-1).
    wsess = str(stash.get("session") or "")
    reads = [with_round("b-wallh", "wall", ["hash"],
                        {"turn_id": turn} if unread else {"seq": {"gt": cover}}, session=wsess)]
    if keep and not unread:
        reads.append(with_round("b-keeph", "wall", ["hash"], {"seq": {"in": keep}},
                                session=wsess))
    reads.append(("b-slotsh", sel("slots", ["path", "hash"])))
    reads.append(with_round("b-pins", "pins", ["hash"]))
    reads.append(with_round("b-cover", "summaries", ["covers_to_seq"], None,
                            [("covers_to_seq", "desc")], 1))
    ops += [r for r in reads if r]
    out.insert(0, lstore(ops, "win-hashes", "curator-policy", pid, ""))
    if _MEM["heal"] is None:
        # GH #1225 (re-check I-4): the heal of an older ledger, once per child
        # and off the call's path -- every session and every pin, not only
        # the round the person talks in (phase `h`).
        _MEM["heal"] = {"run": uuid.uuid4().hex[:12], "firsts": set(), "rows": 0}
        extra.append(heal_stamp())
    cands = sweep_candidates([str(r.get("key") or "") for r in rows(lg, "a-pend")])
    if cands:
        # GH #1225 (A13): off the call's path, after it.
        extra.append(lstore([("s-rows", sel("state", ["key", "value"], {"key": {"in": cands}}))],
                            "s", ME, "", session + "\t" + turn))
    out[1:1] = extra
    emit(out)

if kind_lane == "in_llm":
    call = str(stash.get("call") or "")
    # The parked tap alone (C1 finding W M-6/M-7): since GH #943 the policy
    # keeps a round's last and armed call as `last_call:<rk>`/`armed_call:<rk>`
    # and reads them in its own steps; the bare keys this read also named are
    # read by nobody.
    # GH #1038: beside it the policy's projection of the call (`window_est`),
    # which measures the window when the usage is a continuation's sum.
    ops.append(("b-state", sel("state", ["key", "value"],
                               {"key": {"in": [pending_key(pid), "window_est:" + call]}})))
    ops.append(("b-drop", {"operation": "delete", "table": "state",
                           "where": {"key": pending_key(pid)}}))
    ops.append(("b-drop-est", {"operation": "delete", "table": "state",
                               "where": {"key": "window_est:" + call}}))
    out.insert(0, lstore(ops, "tap", "curator-policy", call, ""))
    out[1:1] = extra
    emit(out)

ops.append(("b-drop", {"operation": "delete", "table": "state",
                       "where": {"key": pending_key(pid)}}))
ack = stash.get("ack") if kind_lane == "in_candidate" else None
if isinstance(ack, dict) and (lg.get("a-cands") or {}).get("error_code"):
    ack = dict(ack, stored=0, ids=[], refused=list(ack.get("refused") or [])
               + [{"id": i, "error_code": "store_error"} for i in ack.get("ids") or []])
out.insert(0, lstore(ops, "done", ME, pid, "ack:" + json.dumps(ack) if isinstance(ack, dict) else ""))
out[1:1] = extra
emit(out)

nothing_block.description: The contract's nothing-form for the sentence a model says beside a tool call (GH #871 I-1): one JSON object, rendered as a sidecar fence after such a sentence when it carries no block of its own, so the sentence stands in later windows with a precedent. Empty (the default) = off. A talky runs the value of its splitter's `nothing_block`.

pass_sections.description: The sections of the model's sidecar block that leave the hive again UNCHANGED on `sidecar` after their mark is written, comma-separated (GH #892): a talky names `memory`, so its memory keeps the one door it has (R-27-2 Pkt. 6); a core that keeps no memory names nothing. Empty (the default) = none.

things_section.description: "1": a `things` section of the model's sidecar block (GH #949) leaves the hive as `thing_seen` -- its entries checked in form (`name` a non-empty string, `kind`/`note` strings; no count and no length of their own, GH #1085), the section within a tenth of the served model's window (`input_soft`; the first entry alone over it clipped with a mark, the rest named in `cut` and `hop.cuts`; no window: whole), with the round in `context.audience_set`, never without one. Anything else (the default "0"): the section is dropped, as one nobody offered. Set it together with `./schemas` `things_section`, which offers the section.

replay_channel_prefix.description: GH #1018, lab replay only. Empty (the default): every episode carries the ingest time. Set: a turn whose `context.channel` starts with this prefix and whose context carries `happened_at` (ISO 8601; the HTTP door puts a request header there) keeps that time as its episode's `happened_at` end to end -- curator writer hop, member edge, memory-hive episode, extracted `valid_from`. Every other channel, and an unreadable time, gets the ingest time. The guard is the instance, not the channel: the channel name is the caller's at the HTTP door (and on the peer path), so on an instance with the prefix set any such caller can backdate a memory by choosing a matching name; set it only on a lab instance. Bridged channels (telegram, phone) never match unless the prefix collides with their names. Never set it on a live instance.

pending_sweep_s.description: GH #1225 (A13): a parked payload of this cell (`pending:*`) older than this many seconds (at least 60) is swept on the next round of the person -- never by a timer of its own -- with one `pending_swept` mark `{keys, older_than_s}` naming the rows the store took; a payload without `parked_at` is never swept.

reject_reason.description: GH #1079: on `reject`, why an item of a checked section fell -- `quote_missing` or `quote_not_in_source`

section.description: GH #1079: on `reject`, the section the item was in (on `sidecar`, the section handed on)

field.description: GH #1079: on `reject`, the item's first field that failed

session_id.description: GH #1079: on `reject`, the session of the turn

turn_id.description: GH #1079: on `reject`, the turn the section answered, as its hop named it

episode_turn_id.description: GH #1079: on `reject`, the person's episode of that turn

verify_answer.description: GH #1079: beside a section whose `hop.sidecar_verify` names a field `answer`, the answer text the splitter cut; never handed on

description.purpose: The one writer of the wall: every element that enters the model's window -- a turn of the running round, the model's final answer off the tap, a durable system slot, a gap's find `./push` kept for the next round -- becomes a block (once per hash) and a wall row (once per session, turn, hash and copy); a section of the model's sidecar block becomes `marks` rows, a pin of another hive a block of kind `pin` and a `pins` row, a push candidate (`in_candidate`, GH #949) a block of kind `candidate` and one `candidates` row per source and id; the `things` section leaves again as `thing_seen` and writes nothing. Two steps per message against the ledger: park the payload and read what is there in one bundle, then write only what is new. Since GH #1079 it also checks a section the parent's splitter stamped with a `sidecar_verify` rule: every item's quoted fields word for word against the round's turns, its memory bundle or the answer, before the section leaves on `sidecar`.
description.not_in_scope: No window, no model call, no episode shape: it hands the window to `./policy` and the participant turns to `./writer`.
description.emits_meaning: lstore: ledger operations (`hop.phase`, `hop.reply_cell` say who reads the answer). episode: the participant turns just written, for `./writer`. pack_ack: the receipt of a pack. sidecar: a section named in `pass_sections`, unchanged, back on the route it came out of the splitter on. candidate_ack: the receipt of one `in_candidate`, only when its `hop.ack` was "1" -- `{source, stored, refused: [{id, error_code}]}`, `hop.error_code` set when the whole body was refused. thing_seen: the checked entries of a `things` section, `{items, turn_id, episode_turn_id?, session_id}`, with the round in context. `sidecar` also carries a checked section (GH #1079): its items with `verified`, a failed one dropped or, under `mode` mark, kept with `failed`; and `reject` one refused item each -- `reject_reason`, `section`, `field`, `session_id`, `turn_id`, `episode_turn_id` on the hop, `messages: []`, never the item's words.
description.consumes_meaning: The eight lanes in_curate, in_slots, in_llm, in_pack, in_section, in_pin, in_addendum (from `./push`: a gap's find as a `memory_recall` pair, for the round it opens) and in_candidate (`{source, candidates: [{id, text, audience_set?, triggers?, until?, once?, priority?}], withdraw?: [id]}`, the round in `context.audience_set`), and the ledger's answers to its own two steps. On `in_section`, `hop.sidecar_verify` (the section's rule, canonical JSON) and the body slot `verify_answer` when the rule checks against the answer (GH #1079).
